deploy.on_merge: Nothing deploys on merge. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) checks syntax, runs the tests and the Surface conformance check, and dry-builds the Worker (`wrangler versions upload --dry-run`). A release is `npm run release:upload` (a new Worker version) followed by promotion by the owner session, following RECOVERY.md.
deploy.after_deploy: RECOVERY.md: re-read the deployment status and script ETag, stop if anything changed, GET-check the routes at a staged allocation, then promote. The memory note sinovai-duality (2026-07) records propagation skew: the first request after a deploy may reach the old version.
deploy.rules: AGENTS.md: ask before push, external publication, deployment or credential changes, and run npm run check, npm test, npm run test:surface and npm run build after Worker changes.

notes: The Worker (src/worker.js, routes sinovai.com/* and www.sinovai.com/*) serves every page. The HTML lives in template literals in src/pages/*.js; site.html lists the six museum rooms (not a glob: museum-catalogue.js and room-creation.js in the same folder hold no head), so once a kit exists the check compares each room's theme-color, color-scheme and icon links with the kit's.

No serve target yet: wrangler.toml has no static-assets binding, so no folder holds served files. Before a kit lands, either add an [assets] directory (for example ../public) and name it in serve.to, or import the files into the Worker from a folder in src/ and name that folder.
check.mjs is not wired yet; planned: `npm run test:brand` (node brand/check.mjs) as a step in .github/workflows/ci.yml, beside npm test.
